agent.proposedText: Guessing Antora anchors: cross-page `xref` anchors for ordinary headings are the heading lowercased with spaces turned into hyphens (`#setting-the-target-ruby-version`), not Asciidoctor's `_`-prefixed default. Anchors in `cops_*.adoc` are explicit `[#...]` ids written by `to_anchor` in `lib/rubocop/cops_documentation_generator.rb` (the cop name without `/`, lowercased, e.g. `#layoutfirstarrayelementlinebreak`). When in doubt, put an explicit `[#my-anchor]` above the heading.
